title: Reckoning What Was Owed on a Ridgecrest Advantage Premium Account When the Coverage Ended
content:
**Clause 1.** Where a Ridgecrest Advantage Medicare Advantage Health Plan enrollment is billed quarterly and at least 2 plan premium charges stand on the premium account, the plan premium reckoned as owed when the coverage ended is every plan premium charge posted on the account in the contract year.

**Clause 2.** Where the enrollment is billed monthly and at least 2 plan premium charges stand on the premium account, the plan premium reckoned as owed when the coverage ended is the plan premium charges posted on the account in the last 3 months.

**Clause 3.** Where fewer than 2 plan premium charges stand on the premium account, the plan premium reckoned as owed when the coverage ended is the most recent plan premium charge standing on it.

The cadence recorded on the enrollment is what tells Clause 1 from Clause 2, and neither of them is reached until at least 2 plan premium charges stand on the premium account. Clause 3 governs on either cadence.

*A terminated enrollment billed quarterly whose premium account carries 2 plan premium charges of 267.90 USD each, both posted in the contract year.* Clause 1 governs, and the plan premium reckoned as owed when the coverage ended is 535.80 USD.

*A terminated enrollment billed monthly whose premium account carries 4 plan premium charges, of which 2 fall inside the last 3 months.* Clause 2 governs, and the plan premium reckoned as owed when the coverage ended is those 2 charges.

*A terminated enrollment whose premium account carries a single plan premium charge.* Clause 3 governs, and the plan premium reckoned as owed when the coverage ended is that charge.
